home-desk.alt: The nurses' desk at night. You sit under a lamp reading a message on a screen; Bea leans on the desk with a mug of tea; Wick, the little clockwork owl, sits on the corner of the desk in the lamplight.

ch00-tube.alt: A tall brass speaking tube rises from a sleek dark cabinet on the corner of the nurses' desk, glowing faintly teal. You and Bea regard it warily; Bea holds a printed letter.

ch00-cupboard.alt: In the supply cupboard, by torchlight, you find the little clockwork owl on a high shelf among boxes of gauze, a paper tag tied to its foot.

ch03-opener.alt: Under the desk lamp, you fit a row of small brass knobs across Wick's chest with a jeweller's screwdriver while Bea looks on, mug in hand.

ch03-training.alt: Wick sits alone on the desk while the knobs on its chest turn by themselves, a long strip of paper tape pouring out.

ch10-opener.alt: Wick sits on the desk fitted with two slender brass arms, one holding the desk phone's handset to its ear and the other a pager, while a strip of its paper tape runs back across the desk into Lyceum's speaking tube. You and Bea watch from your chairs.

ch10-slip.alt: A fanned stack of paper records on the desk, one slip among them giving off a faint teal glow, while Wick's brass arm reaches toward it.
